3.  The present application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking grant of pre-arrest bail in FIR No. 863/2023 dated 23.11.2023 registered at Police Station Keshav Puram for offences under Sections 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
4.

It is further alleged that co-accused Priyanka Bhardwaj and her associates in collusion with each other had cheated the complainant and gave forged and fabricated Visas causing wrongful loss to the complainant and other persons of 29.80 Lakhs, approximately.

sentences.text: The learned senior counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been made accused only on an allegation that he, being the Father-in-Law of the main accused, Priyanka Bhardwaj had introduced the Father-in-Law of the complainant to her since she used to work as a Visa consultant.
6. He further submits that the applicant has nothing to do with the business or financial interest of the co-accused, Priyanka Bhardwaj.
He submits that the applicant is running a garment shop for his livelihood, and is a 70 year old man suffering from various ailments.
7. The learned counsel for the complainant, who appears through video-conferencing submits that the applicant is the main accused.

8. Considering the fact that the applicant is 70 years old and during the hearing of the bail application filed by the co-accused, Priyanka Bhardwaj, it was contended on behalf of the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State as well as the learned counsel for the complainant that co-accused Priyanka Bhardwaj is the main accused, this Court considers it apposite that subject to the applicant joining and cooperating with the investigation, he be not arrested till the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.

The applicant is also directed to provide his mobile phone number to the concerned Investigating Officer, which shall remain switched on, at all times.
10. Issue Notice.

11. Reply, if any, be filed before the next date of hearing.
12.

AMIT MAHAJAN, J MARCH 15, 2024 "SS"
